newsitem.title: USA: EMC Corp says rescinds buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: EMC Corp says rescinds buyback plan.

text.p: EMC Corp said on Monday it has decided to rescind its plan to buy back up to 15 million shares of its common stock.
In January, the company had planned to buy back up to that many shares over five years, a move designed primarily to meet the requirements of the company's employee stock plans.
EMC said the program is being rescinded to avoid any potential issues regarding the pooling of interests merger accounting treatment it has often used in its past acquisitions.
A spokesman for EMC did not immediately return a telephone call for comment.
EMC spokesman Mark Fredrickson said the plan was rescinded, in part, to avoid any potential issues regarding possible future acquisitions.
